decision.odds_reasoning: Based on historical desk win rates for forex macro and the neutral stance of our specialist scoring models, the edge is insufficient to justify risking capital.
decision.thesis: We are passing on CAD_JPY as technicals and sentiment remain neutral within a mixed sideways trend. Although minor pullbacks to the 20-day average are visible, the lack of a strong directional catalyst and conflicting positioning make this an unfavorable setup. We prefer to allocate capital to higher-conviction tactical opportunities elsewhere.
decision.invalidation: A decisive breakout above the 20-day high of 113.67 accompanied by strong macro confirmation.
decision.plain_english: We are passing on this trade because the technical indicators [gauges of price direction and momentum] and market sentiment do not provide a strong enough edge. The currency pair is moving sideways without a clear trend. Sitting in cash is better than forcing a sub-optimal trade.
